title: Cloud City: Google Global Infrastructure & Network Tiers
city_concept: City International Airports, Transit Hubs, and High-Speed Rail

beats.name: The City Problem
beats.story: Bea wanted to ship bread to Paris. She handed parcels to random hitchhikers on public dirt roads. Packages got lost, spoiled, or delayed by traffic.

beats.name: The City Solution
beats.story: Mayor Meridian connected Cloud City to a private high-speed dedicated maglev railway (Google Global Fiber Network) with secured customs terminals.

beats.name: City Under Stress
beats.story: A landslide blocked one international railway tunnel. The central dispatch automatically diverted trains through an alternative mountain tunnel in milliseconds.

beats.name: Where Metaphor Breaks
beats.story: In public roads, potholes and tollbooths delay traffic; on Google's private B4 network, packets travel at two-thirds the speed of light in vacuum.
